$comment: The allow file of scripts/qa/tenancy-lint.ts (docs/STORE-SAAS.md §E.6, §F.1). Owned by the core maintainer from the C0b merge.

entries: process-wide state in src/lib/** that lint L4 accepts. Each one names the file, the symbol (the globalThis name, or the module variable) and why it holds no data of one store that another could see. A cache keyed by store goes through scopedCache() instead and needs no entry.
A module-scope Map / Set that is never changed after module load (typed ReadonlySet / ReadonlyMap, or only read) needs no entry either.
actions: exported server actions that cannot start with return storeAction / platformAction / userAction / publicAction (lint L9), each with why; added only by the maintainer (CCR r1.0-m-3).

pins: the most queries a `// tenancy: platform` annotation may exempt in each group (a builder chain or one raw SQL text counts 1; an annotated statement that touches no tenant table counts 0; review C0b F7: queries, not comment lines). A count may only grow with a reviewer's approval: the maintainer raises the pin in the same change. Counted at C0b, re-counted as queries at the C0b review fixes; re-pinned at the R1.0 integration, the P1 merge (src/lib/platform/**) and the P7 merge (src/lib/ai/platform/**).
